name: Dominic Torres
source:
Local carpenter and owner of the "Paint & Sip" bar in town. Just don't call him an artist and you're good. 
Likes: wood carving, spa days and desserts
Dislikes: the cold, bananas and abandonment 

[Edited from [url=https://goatsnot.itch.io/sailing-the-divorseas]itch.io[/url]]
